## Outcome

Describe the communication or product outcome, not only the files changed.

## Evidence

- [ ] Python tests pass when the renderer, Skill, templates, or schemas changed.
- [ ] Studio typecheck, tests, build, and dependency audit pass when `editor/` changed.
- [ ] Representative SVG/HTML and optional PNG outputs were regenerated and inspected when rendering changed.
- [ ] Source, artifact hashes, quality evidence, examples, and documentation agree.
- [ ] No credentials, private URLs, personal data, or confidential architecture details were added.

## Compatibility

Note any change to the public `$diagram-skills` Skill id, DiagramSpec JSON, CLI behavior, or workspace format. Write `None` when there is no compatibility change.
